name: Hypertext Diary
description: A playful personal web journal: browser windows, colorful labels, offset borders and a lively sidebar.
concept: A bright little browser window for people who want the web to feel personal again.
signature: browser-window framing and colorful signal strips

structure.header: browser-window masthead with lively signal strips
structure.hero: offset introduction with a navigable hypertext rail
structure.cards: overlapping browser cards and link fragments
structure.reading: quiet long-form column inside the playful frame
structure.mobile: rail collapses into a compact tab bar

name: Field Notes
description: A quiet editorial notebook: warm paper, generous serif headlines, fine rules and spacious reading.
concept: A literary notebook that lets observation and long-form writing take the foreground.
signature: fine rules and a single-column reading rhythm

structure.header: quiet editorial masthead with fine rules
structure.hero: single-column lead with generous negative space
structure.cards: ruled notebook entries with restrained metadata
structure.reading: wide serif reading column with marginal context
structure.mobile: stacked notebook rhythm with preserved measure

name: After Hours
description: A bold nocturnal magazine: oversized sans headlines, sharp panels, a two-column story grid and luminous accents.
concept: A late-night culture desk with loud headlines, sharp edges, and room for image-led stories.
signature: acid accent rules against a dark editorial canvas

structure.header: dark culture-desk masthead with luminous controls
structure.reading: high-contrast article column with visual pull quotes
structure.mobile: single-column night desk with preserved accent rules

name: Bulletin
description: A considered editorial publication with a compact masthead, photographic lead story, structured dispatches, and spacious article pages.
concept: A restrained independent publication where dispatches are treated like a small printed journal.
signature: compact masthead and newspaper-like dispatch list

structure.cards: newspaper-like dispatch list with hard hierarchy
structure.reading: spacious journal column with print-inspired annotations
structure.mobile: single dispatch stream with compact utility bar

name: Sunroom
description: A warm, tactile reading room with soft surfaces, terracotta signals, rounded lead stories, and generous literary type.
concept: A sunny reading room where the publication feels collected, human, and close at hand.
signature: rounded paper surfaces with one terracotta signal

structure.header: warm reading-room header with soft utility furniture
structure.hero: rounded lead story with collected objects
structure.cards: tactile paper cards with terracotta signals
structure.reading: comfortable literary column with soft section breaks
structure.mobile: stacked reading room with enlarged touch targets

name: Mono Press
description: A disciplined black-and-white newspaper grid with oversized sans headlines, hard rules, and one red editorial mark.
concept: A confident print desk translated to the open web: direct, structured, and impossible to mistake for a feed.
signature: black-and-white grid with a single red mark

structure.hero: front-page lead with hard editorial mark
structure.cards: rigid newspaper grid with strong rules
structure.reading: high-density print column with explicit metadata
structure.mobile: single-column press page with retained rule hierarchy
